result.stdout:
> nugetz — A modern CLI for NuGet packages

USAGE:
  nugetz <command> [options]

COMMANDS:
  install       <package>   Install a NuGet package into one or more projects
  search        <query>    Search for NuGet packages
  info          <package>   Show detailed package information
  doctor                    Check local projects, dependencies, updates, and 
advisories
  upgrade       [package]  Preview or apply local project package updates
  validate      [package]  Pack and validate a package without publishing
  publish       [project]  Pack and publish to nuget.org
  apikey        <sub>       Manage NuGet API key (set|remove|status)

OPTIONS:
  --help, -h          Show help
  --version           Show version
